draft.rationale: The edit grows a two-branch switch on the export format into three branches whose bodies carry their own template loading, rendering and archiving, so the next format has to edit this function again.
A fourth delivery channel is added as another case with its own address normalisation and provider call, inside a switch that already held three channels' behaviour.
The new provider is wired by adding a case that knows the provider's endpoint and response reader, extending a three-provider switch whose branches each hold their own request.
A third index type is added as a case that opens a different client and writes a different document shape, turning a two-case switch into a three-case one that the next index type must edit.
The edit adds a fifth output format as a case whose body builds the file itself, on a switch that already carries four formats' rendering behaviour.
A fourth section kind is rendered by adding a case with its own layout, measurement and markup building, extending a switch whose branches each hold one kind's markup.
A third else-if branch on the charge kind is added, holding the new kind's lookup and formatting inline, so a fourth kind means another branch here.
An instanceof branch for a third shape is added with its own geometry, so shape knowledge now lives in a growing instanceof chain that every new shape must edit.
A typeof branch for a new primitive payload kind is added with its own escaping and envelope building, growing a two-branch typeof chain to three.
A fourth gateway name gets its own else-if branch with signature verification and event mapping, added to a chain that already branches per gateway name.
A third job type is handled by an added else-if branch that fetches its own input and writes its own output, so job behaviour keeps accumulating in one run method.
The same edit adds the new document kind in two dispatch chains of one class, a validate chain and a render switch, so a variant now needs edits in two places.
The edit extends the existing assign chain with the new ticket kind and also creates a second kind-dispatch chain in summarise, so one new variant needed two edits in one class and the next will too.
The new record kind is added in both the import chain and the export chain of the same class, each with its own field mapping, so the variant is spread across two chains.
The switch is the single composition point that maps a format tag to one importer instance; the added case is one line building the constructor, which is the stated exception.
The else-if chain only chooses which handler object to build, one branch and one constructor per variant, so it is the designated composition point rather than variant behaviour held inline.
Each case only returns a constant label, so this is a lookup table in switch clothing and adding one row is cosmetic rather than behaviour held inline.
The added else-if only selects a constant tier name, so the chain is a table that returns labels and the exception for pure value mapping applies.
The added branch is a type and emptiness guard on one field, not a dispatch on a variant tag; the branches build a list of validation problems and nothing about the set of variants changes.

The new branches compare an amount range and a feature flag inside one price calculation; they are guards on values, not branches on a variant tag, so no variant's behaviour is being added to a dispatch chain.
The switch is over the seven days of the week, a closed set that will not grow, so the exception for closed stable sets applies even though a case with real work was added.
The switch is over the five HTTP status classes, a closed set fixed by the protocol, so adding the informational class is not a growing product variant dispatch.
The edit removes the per-channel switch and leaves one table of senders, so the chain that new channels had to edit is gone and no nudge is warranted.
The inline else-if behaviour is replaced by one renderer class per snippet kind and a lookup over them, so the chain that new kinds had to edit is gone and no nudge is warranted.
The edit grows a single condition into a two-branch chain, which is too early to call a growing dispatch; the rule's threshold is three branches.
A typeof check gains a second arm for arrays, leaving two branches; with fewer than three branches the chain is not yet a growing variant dispatch.
The table maps a connector name to a zero-argument constructor, one entry per variant with no behaviour inline, so a new connector is one row and nothing grows.
The switch on label format with inline rendering was already there and stays exactly as it was; the edit only adds an unrelated estimate method with a typeof guard, so the chain is untouched debt.

The else-if chain on plan kind with inline billing behaviour was already there and the edit only renames a local and adds a log line in another method, so the chain is untouched debt rather than a new extension.
Both dispatch chains on the entry kind were already in the class and the edit only hardens the amount parsing inside one existing branch, adding no variant and no new chain.
A new pure helper that rounds cents to the nearest step; there is no conditional over a type tag and nothing a variant would extend.

shape: single type check without a chain

draft.rationale: One instanceof normalisation of an input value, in a helper that has no other branch on the value; nothing dispatches per variant.
The added instanceof branch classifies a thrown error for retry and rethrows everything it does not recognise, which is error handling rather than a chain over product variants.
One early return for a document that is already archived; a single guard on one record's state is not a chain that variants extend.
A new module of string normalisation helpers with no branch on a tag, so there is nothing to dispatch over.
The new method wraps one upload call, retries once and rethrows a typed error; there is no conditional over a tag and no per-variant behaviour.
A new defaults module that merges a partial settings object with literals; defaults use ?? on values, with no branch on a variant tag.
The added typeof guard rejects a non numeric total at the boundary and carries no per-variant behaviour.

shape: typeof on a runtime value, not a variant tag

draft.rationale: The typeof branch accepts a listener that arrives as a direct callable alongside a stored list; it tests a runtime value's shape rather than dispatching per domain variant.
The typeof checks live inside one comparison used to order mixed cells; it is a comparator guard and no branch selects behaviour per variant.
